weatherBasis.description: Typical meteorological year using solar data from AUS_NSW_Dubbo.City.Rgnl.AP.957190_TMYx.2011-2025.epw at Dubbo.City.Rgnl.AP (WMO 957190) and wind data from AUS_NSW_Armidale.AP.957730_TMYx.2011-2025.epw at Armidale.AP (WMO 957730), applied to the dispatch period by calendar hour.
